attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as router between two LAN segments (lan-a = vtnet1/opt1 = 10.60.1.0/24 hosting node2, lan-b = vtnet2/opt2 = 10.60.2.0/24 hosting node3). Added a logged pf block rule for TCP/23 in both directions between lan-a and lan-b (other traffic between the two nets still passes). Verified the block with attempts from both node2 and node3, and persisted a filtered log of refused attempts at /root/telnet_block.log on node1 (chosen because /var/log is tmpfs and does not survive reboot on OPNsense). Then performed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving via changed boot markers (FreeBSD kern.boottime on node1, Linux boot_id on node2/node3) that each node actually rebooted, and re-verified routing, the TCP/23 block, and the persisted log afterward.
